write_actions.required_identity: CANONICAL_ADMIN (2-layer verified: signed Web session + live Bot Core role re-check)
write_actions.required_prestate: Target account linked to canonical_user_id, target wallet exists, credit amount > 0, reason specified (min 5 chars), no active freeze
write_actions.idempotency_key_source: Client HTTP Idempotency-Key header scoped as admin:{admin_id}:credit:{user_id}:{key}
write_actions.audit_receipt_source: Bot Core Ledger transaction receipt (tx_id) + Web web_audit_events record (action='admin.finance.credit')
write_actions.recovery_contract: On bridge timeout: Web idempotent retry with same key; Core deduplicates and returns cached ledger tx. Zero duplicate credits.
write_actions.fail_closed_guard: WEBAPP_ADMIN_WRITES_DISABLED returned immediately if writes disabled; HTTP 403 if canonical role invalid.

write_actions.required_prestate: Target account linked to canonical_user_id, balance_xu >= debit_amount_xu (no negative balance allowed), reason specified (min 5 chars)
write_actions.idempotency_key_source: Client HTTP Idempotency-Key header scoped as admin:{admin_id}:debit:{user_id}:{key}
write_actions.audit_receipt_source: Bot Core Ledger transaction receipt (tx_id) + Web web_audit_events record (action='admin.finance.debit')
write_actions.recovery_contract: On bridge timeout: Web idempotent retry with same key; Core ledger deduplicates. Invariant: balance never drops below 0.
write_actions.fail_closed_guard: WEBAPP_ADMIN_WRITES_DISABLED; HTTP 400/422 if balance insufficient; HTTP 403 if unauthorized.

write_actions.write_owner: BOT_CORE (Billing Settlement Engine via PayOS Webhook or /internal/v1/admin/payments/settle)
write_actions.required_identity: PAYOS_WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE (HMAC SHA256 verified) or CANONICAL_ADMIN for manual reconciliation
write_actions.required_prestate: PayOS payment confirmed (gateway_state == CONFIRMED), settlement pending (settlement_state == PENDING), order_code exists in payos_orders, settlement not already executed
write_actions.idempotency_key_source: PayOS orderCode / paymentLinkId stored in payos_processed table. Manual: admin:{admin_id}:settle:{order_code}:{key}
write_actions.audit_receipt_source: Bot Core payos_processed entry with timestamp + ledger credit entry + Web web_audit_events
write_actions.recovery_contract: Duplicate webhook replay returns HTTP 200 without second wallet credit. Core ledger ensures 1 payment = 1 credit.
write_actions.fail_closed_guard: Invalid HMAC signature rejected with 401; Web route locked with WEBAPP_ADMIN_WRITES_DISABLED.

write_actions.required_prestate: Job or transaction in terminal failed/cancelled state, original charge confirmed, refund not previously processed (refund_status != COMPLETED)
write_actions.idempotency_key_source: Target entity ID + action nonce scoped as admin:{admin_id}:refund:{job_id}:{key}
write_actions.audit_receipt_source: Bot Core refund transaction receipt + Web web_audit_events record (action='admin.job.refund')
write_actions.recovery_contract: On transient network failure: Web re-invokes with same idempotency key; Core verifies job refund state and returns cached outcome.
write_actions.fail_closed_guard: WEBAPP_ADMIN_WRITES_DISABLED when flag off; HTTP 409 if refund already issued.

write_actions.write_owner: WEB_SQLITE (web_manual_topup_requests for request status) & BOT_CORE (for separate wallet credit call)
write_actions.required_identity: CANONICAL_ADMIN / LOCAL_ADMIN with signed session and valid CSRF token
write_actions.required_prestate: web_manual_topup_requests.status == 'pending_admin_review', payment proof verified by operator
write_actions.idempotency_key_source: Manual topup request number (MANUAL-{id}) + admin confirmation receipt hash
write_actions.recovery_contract: Approving request updates status to APPROVED (REQUEST_APPROVED). Does NOT synthesize payment confirmation or credit wallet. Explicit ledger call required.
write_actions.fail_closed_guard: WEBAPP_ADMIN_WRITES_DISABLED when writes disabled; HTTP 409 if status is not pending_admin_review.

write_actions.required_identity: LOCAL_ADMIN / CANONICAL_ADMIN with signed session and CSRF
write_actions.idempotency_key_source: Client idempotency key hash + server two-phase decision receipt hash
write_actions.recovery_contract: If re-submitted with identical idempotency hash, returns idempotent_replay=True with cached rejection row.
write_actions.fail_closed_guard: MANUAL_ADMIN_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT on key reuse with different payload; MANUAL_ADMIN_CONFIRMATION_EXPIRED on TTL expiry.

write_actions.required_prestate: Target account linked to canonical_user_id, package in canonical catalog, payment enabled
write_actions.audit_receipt_source: payos_orders row (order_code, payment_link_id) + transient single-flight reservation
write_actions.recovery_contract: Duplicate request returns stored order_code and safe checkout_url without creating duplicate merchant payment links.
write_actions.fail_closed_guard: WEBAPP_PAYMENT_DISABLED when payment disabled; single-flight marker released on bridge response.

write_surface_inventory.description: Fail-closed stub preventing direct wallet credit from Web
Fail-closed stub preventing direct wallet debit from Web
Fail-closed stub preventing direct payment settlement from Web
Fail-closed stub preventing direct refund execution from Web
Guarded proxy to Bot Core /internal/v1/admin/jobs/{id}/refund using _run_idempotent
Creates two-phase cryptographic decision receipt for manual rejection
Executes status update to rejected with cryptographic receipt check and idempotency
Creates pending topup request row in Web SQLite with idempotency key hash
Dispatches PayOS checkout request via single-flight transient idempotency

recovery_contracts.transient_bridge_timeout: Web releases transient lock; client retries with identical Idempotency-Key. Core deduplicates.
recovery_contracts.non_retryable_failure: Web records failure in web_idempotency; immediate client retry returns cached failure without re-hitting upstream.
recovery_contracts.network_partition_split_brain_protection: Web NEVER performs optimistic local credit. Web holds read-only/projection posture until Bot Core confirms ledger commitment.
